# Organization Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:OrganizationType`](gmeow-OrganizationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/OrganizationType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of an organization — a VALUE, never an [`Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md) subclass. The set is open; a kind not among the seed individuals is a FRESH [`gmeow:OrganizationType`](gmeow-OrganizationType.md) individual carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label), not a new class.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:OrganizationType`](gmeow-OrganizationType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the organization-kind axis — the open set (company, nonprofit, government body, association, collaboration, …) referenced through [`gmeow:organizationType`](../properties/gmeow-organizationType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md) by kind (kinds are values, not classes — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid reusing an ill-fitting seed; mint a fresh [`gmeow:OrganizationType`](gmeow-OrganizationType.md) individual when the kind is missing.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:OrganizationType`](gmeow-OrganizationType.md) individual from an organization via [`gmeow:organizationType`](../properties/gmeow-organizationType.md), or mint a new individual carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition) when the open set lacks the kind.

### Examples

- ex:orgTypeCooperative a [`gmeow:OrganizationType`](gmeow-OrganizationType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "cooperative"@en.
